Natalie Portman as Novalee Nation, a pregnant 17-year-old from Tennessee whose boyfriend Willy Jack Pickens (Dylan Bruno), an aspiring country singer, drives off to California and abandons her at a Wal-Mart in Sequoyah, Oklahoma; she secretly lives inside the Wal-Mart and gives birth there at night, helped by Forney Hull (James Frain), a shy librarian; the baby is named Americus. Ashley Judd as Lexie Coop, a nurse with many children who becomes her best friend; Stockard Channing as Thelma 'Sister' Husband, a kind religious woman who takes her in; Keith David as Moses Whitecotton, a photographer who teaches her photography; Sally Field as Mama Lil, Novalee's mother; Joan Cusack as Ruth Meyers, a music agent who manages Willy Jack; Mr. Sprock is the Wal-Mart manager; Roger is Lexie's boyfriend; Mary Elizabeth is Forney's sister. Willy Jack goes to jail, becomes a country singer, then loses his legs in a train accident. A tornado hits the town. Novalee and Forney end up together and marry in the Wal-Mart.
